instrument: Major site plan approval, QLevr LLC data center, Carmen Avenue East (Sept 28, 2026)
summary: City Council approved the major site plan for a roughly 55,000 sq ft data center, covering architecture, landscaping, light output and parking. A development contract and building permit are still required before construction.
notes: Next steps per the city page: development contract, then building permit.
confidence_note: Council action not read in minutes; vote count not reported in the source seen.
